
```{r}
#put the tables into a list
tables <- list(C16, C17, C18, C19, C20, C21, C22, C23, C24, C25, C26)

combined <- do.call(rbind, lapply(16:26, function(clone) {
  obj <- get(paste0("C", clone))
  obj$clone <- clone
  return(obj)
}))

#Add significance column
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(sig = ifelse(p_holm < 0.05, "significant", "not significant"))

#Write table
write.table(combined, "/Users/cmdb/trip-genomic-context/rnaseq/results/distances.txt")

```

```{r}
#Classify gene as being within, upstream or downstream of IR. I asked HOPGPT which showed a the if then statement.
#If the IR is 
combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    #RAW distance means it is not strand aware yet
    raw_distance = case_when(
      IR_start >= gene_start & IR_start <= gene_end ~ 0,
      IR_start < gene_start ~ IR_start - gene_start,
      IR_start > gene_end ~ IR_start - gene_end
    ),
    # strand aware (+ = downstream), (- = upstream)
    distance = case_when(
      raw_distance == 0 ~ 0, #Within gene
  
      # Positive strand gene
      # left of gene = upstream = negative
      # right of gene = downstream = positive
      gene_strand == "+" ~ raw_distance,
      
      # Negative strand gene
      # left of gene = downstream = positive
      # right of gene = upstream = negative
      gene_strand == "-" ~ -raw_distance
    ),
    # Add position label
    position = case_when(
      distance == 0 ~ "intragenic",
      distance > 0 ~ "downstream",
      distance < 0 ~ "upstream"
    )
  )

#Add a column for significance (if holms is less than 0.05)
#Break up the the gene_name column by '_'
#ENSID, baseMean, log2FC, lfcSE, pval, padj, gene_name, p_holm

combined <- combined %>%
  mutate(
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FoldChange),
    baseMean = as.numeric(baseMean),
    pval = as.numeric(pvalue),
    padj = as.numeric(padj),
    p_holm = as.numeric(p_holm)
  )

```

```{r}

plot_data <- combined %>%
  filter(!is.na(sig)) %>%
  filter(!is.infinite(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  filter(!is.nan(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(log2FoldChange))

# Check
summary(plot_data$log2FoldChange)
```


```{r}
ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = distance/1000,
                      y = log2FoldChange,
                      color = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("significant" = "red",
                                "not significant" = "black"),
                     labels = c("significant" = "p < 0.05",
                                "not significant" = "p > 0.05")) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0,
             color = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.5) +
  labs(title = "Endogenous genes",
       x = "Distance from IR (kb)",
       y = "log2 (Fold change)",
       color = "") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-100, 100)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = c(-100, -50, 0, 50, 100),
                     labels = c("-100", "-50", "IR", "50", "100")) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.85),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
    
  )

```

```{r}
big <- subset(plot_data, abs(log2FC) > 0.01)

ggplot(big, aes(x = distance / 1000, y = log2FC, colour = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "deepskyblue3") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("not significant" = "black", "significant" = "red")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Distance from IR (kb)", y = "log2 (Fold change)",
       title = "Endogenous genes (|log2FC| > 0.01)") +
  theme_classic()
```
```{r}

big <- subset(plot_data, abs(log2FC) > 0.01)

# Look up gene symbols from Ensembl IDs
big$symbol <- mapIds(org.Mm.eg.db,
                     keys = sub("\\..*$", "", big$gene),
                     keytype = "ENSEMBL", column = "SYMBOL",
                     multiVals = "first")

# Label significant genes: symbol (fall back to Ensembl ID if missing) + clone
big$label <- ifelse(
  big$sig == "significant",
  paste0(ifelse(is.na(big$symbol), big$gene, big$symbol),
         "\n(clone ", big$clone, ")"),
  NA
)

ggplot(big, aes(x = distance / 1000, y = log2FC, colour = sig)) +
  geom_point(size = 1.5) +
  geom_text_repel(aes(label = label), colour = "red", size = 2.8,
                  fontface = "italic",
                  na.rm = TRUE, max.overlaps = Inf,
                  min.segment.length = 0, box.padding = 0.4) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey40") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "deepskyblue3") +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c("not significant" = "black", "significant" = "red")) +
  scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-100, 100)) +
  labs(x = "Distance from IR (kb)", y = "log2 (Fold change)",
       title = "Endogenous genes (|log2FC| > 0.01)") +
  theme_classic()
```
